newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel diffs seen slightly up in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel diffs seen slightly up in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. jet fuel differentials crept slightly higher Monday, but traders said market activity was extremely thin.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil futures were up a modest 0.11 cent at 52.33 cents a gallon.
Few active participants were seen in the Gulf market, traders said, though the prompt 54-grade barrels appeared to move up to 0.25 cent over the NYMEX futures, a gain of about 0.10 cent from Friday.
Prompt USG 55-grade low sulphur diesel changed hands at 0.25 cent over the August futures early in the day, though it was talked at slightly higher levels than than near the NYMEX close.
Prompt conventional 54-grade jet fuel in New York Harbor was seen near 2.25 cents over the futures, the high end of the trading range seen Friday.
